slides.texte_overlay:
how does she speak
so eloquently?

she reads out loud,
ten minutes a day

she picks the precise word,
not "good" or "nice"

she tells stories,
not lists of facts

she ends her sentences
with a falling tone

she always has something
new to say
slides.texte_sophia:
she always has something new
to say. i learn mine on a
micro-learning app like
the Sophia app.
